candidates.title: Sri Lanka hit by islandwide power outage
candidates.excerpt: The cause of the islandwide outage was not immediately clear, although the government said a failure at a hydropower station in the central hill country, detected a day earlier, could have contributed to it

candidates.title: Poland's police warn of a possible plot to attack Prime Minister Donald Tusk
candidates.excerpt: Security services, police, and representatives of the Interior Ministry were scheduled to hold an emergency meeting at 11 am (0900 GMT) on October 11 to discuss the situation, Karolina Galecka, says Interior Ministry spokesperson

candidates.title: ‘Reclaim Jantar Mantar’ march held to demand restoration of designated protest site; several detained
candidates.excerpt: Protesters on Saturday organised a 'Reclaim Jantar Mantar' march, demanding that the iconic location be restored as an officially designated site for demonstrations after the Union government de-notified it for protests on October 12.

candidates.title: Kyiv pushes back on Donald Trump's call for a new Ukrainian president as drones hit Russian data hub
candidates.excerpt: The exchange came as Kyiv pressed its campaign against infrastructure deep inside Russia, with a drone attack shutting down a data centre run by Russian technology giant Yandex

candidates.title: Pakistan President declares emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, provincial government ceases to exist
candidates.excerpt: An emergency allows Pakistan's federal government to assume key executive and legislative powers in a province during a security crisis or breakdown of constitutional governance
